cases.name: Dominique Elizabeth Hawn
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Dominique sought out to make her own ways with life. Making sure she made it what she wanted without question. She gained a second family and looked to Chris and Lesia Hannahs as her other set of parents. Dominique began BMX racing with them and loved it so much.You could see the joy it brought her all over her face. She loved to show off those trophies. It was always such a big accomplishment to her. She once said it was the time of her life. When the bike hit the dirt she didn’t think about anything else. It was a way to clear her thoughts and escape from everyday life. Being with family made all the difference in the world to her. At times when she didn’t know how to be with everyone she still carried our love with her. She was so ambitious and outgoing and would give anything she absolutely could to help those that needed her even if she needed it more. Dominique always had this energy about her that came through that beautiful smile of hers. She truly could light up a room with that smile and laughter. She was such a beautiful soul through and through. She found strength in struggles to get through today and be strong for tomorrow. She was fearless and kind and truly a blessing to have known."
cases.narrative: On 1/5/2022, police found her body in his basement. He had stabbed her more than 200 times and slashed her face stretching from ear to ear. She was covered by a shower curtain behind a marijuana plant and had been dead for days. Sanders recorded much of attack with his phone, and some of those recordings were played for the jury. In the recordings, Sanders can be heard accusing Hawn of trying to set him up by working with federal authorities and threatening to shoot her in the eye while Hawn begs for her life.
